nodes.detail: Use authenticated runtime information for the actually loaded Figma plugin version. A package version, server version, or on-disk file version alone does not establish what Figma loaded.

nodes.title: Replay startup inputs and block uncertain writes
nodes.detail: Persist and replay startup arguments, input pins, and nested source inputs privately. Pin, development, offline, authentication, claimed/uncertain state, unknown source, or forbidden access are explicit exceptions; stale or versionless runtime state blocks writes. Reopen the same plugin only when Desktop did not reload it.
